pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. SF fell behind, CMC finished near that 23-yard last4 floor, and Kittle's 29-yard game showed up again because the Rams took the TE away with a shell this pack never charted. Or the opposite: SF ground the clock, CMC cleared 57.5, and Kittle stuck on 67 and lost by a half-yard. Donald resting did not matter because the rest of the LA front played its normal snaps. Both legs are the same SF offense in a 22-point implied total, so one stalled drive script kills the slip together. These lines may just be 2025 medians with no real price, so a correct read can still be a pick'em. Thompson playing would have been the counter on a Kyren leg we already refused to pair.
